name: pl.droidsonroids.foqa.HyperionDisableProvider
description: The Droids On Roids FoQA quality-assurance tools run this Provider when the app starts. In Firebase Test Lab it detects the test environment and disables Hyperion's startup tools; elsewhere it has no effect.
disableEffect: In Firebase Test Lab, Hyperion may stay enabled; regular app features are unaffected.
